title: The Thirteenth Bell
narration: Our village church rang thirteen times whenever someone was about to disappear. A boy from a forty-year-old missing poster hid me in the tower while villagers, including my father, climbed after us. They claimed one yearly sacrifice protected every child. The boy told me to cut the rope. The bell crashed through the floor, revealing hundreds of bones beneath it. The silence felt deliberate, as though someone nearby was waiting for me to understand the trap before moving again. For several seconds I could hear nothing except my breathing and the small ordinary sounds around me. Every explanation I tried made the details worse, because each clue had been placed where I alone would find it. There was no curse or monster—only generations of murders hidden by the entire village.
